description_en: Configures the Java virtual machine (JVM) parameters for an application or an instance group where the application is deployed
description_zh: 调用UpdateJvmConfiguration来配置应用或应用分组的JVM
name: UpdateJvmConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance group where the application is deployed. You can call the ListDeployGroup operation to query the group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62077.html.



To configure the JVM parameters for an instance group, set this parameter to a specific ID.

To configure the JVM parameters for an application, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62077.html来查询。

如果ID不为空，设置分组信息。
ID为空，则设置应用的配置信息
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom JVM parameters.



If this parameter is not specified in the group configuration, the value specified in the application configuration is used.

If this parameter is not specified in the application configuration, the default value is used
parameters.help_zh:
自定义参数：

分组配置不设置该参数，使用应用配置。
应用配置不设置该参数，使用默认值
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en:
The initial size of the heap memory. Unit: MB.



If this parameter is not specified in the group configuration, the value specified in the application configuration is used.

If this parameter is not specified in the application configuration, the default value is used
parameters.help_zh:
初始化堆内存大小，单位MB：

分组配置不设置该参数，使用应用配置。
应用配置不设置该参数，使用默认值
parameters.name: min_heap_size

parameters.help_en:
The size of the permanent generation heap memory. Unit: MB.



If this parameter is not specified in the group configuration, the value specified in the application configuration is used.

If this parameter is not specified in the application configuration, the default value is used
parameters.help_zh:
持久代内存大小，单位MB：
分组配置不设置该参数，使用应用配置。
应用配置不设置该参数，使用默认值
parameters.name: max_perm_size

parameters.help_en:
The maximum size of the heap memory. Unit: MB.



If this parameter is not specified in the group configuration, the value specified in the application configuration is used.

If this parameter is not specified in the application configuration, the default value is used
parameters.help_zh:
最大堆内存大小，单位MB：
分组配置不设置该参数，使用应用配置。
应用配置不设置该参数，使用默认值
parameters.name: max_heap_size
